admission.IDIOSYNCRATIC_INFORMATION_JUMP: synchronized majority demand is false and frozen signal open_gap>=2%
admission.SYNCHRONIZED_MAJORITY_DEMAND: market daily median return>0 and positive-member share>50%; PIT industry daily median return>0 and positive-member share>50%
admission.combination: logical OR; the two lanes are mutually exclusive

causal_bull.BEAR: both medians <= 0 AND both positive-return shares <= 0.50
causal_bull.BULL: market median ret20 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND market median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
causal_bull.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state
causal_bull.strategy_action: trade only BULL; BEAR and TRANSITION hold cash

economic_hypothesis: A frozen quiet forty-session inventory platform followed by an upward non-limit information gap and high-location volume expansion is a demand repricing event. In a causally known broad BULL market, it is admitted either when both the market and PIT industry show same-session majority participation, or, absent that synchronization, when the stock-specific opening information jump is at least 2%.
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions

evidence_governance.2019_2023: post-discovery chronological stability; not pristine validation
evidence_governance.post_2023_data: permitted only to resolve pre-2024 positions
evidence_governance.reason_not_pristine: outcomes have been observed during autonomous iterative research

independence: No downward collapse gap, repair zone, V6/V7/V26/V27 event identity, feature, signal, or outcome is used.
target: +15% coordinate standing target from first T+1-sellable session
time_stop: completed H15 state, then next legal daily open
